bio.text: Joe Hathaway is the Republican candidate for New Jersey's 11th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 election.
He was born and raised in Clifton, played football at Yale, and worked in Gov. Chris Christie's administration as advance director of special events.
He joined the Randolph Township council in 2022 and was chosen mayor of Randolph in early 2025, the position he held when he announced his congressional run in October 2025.

sources.title: Randolph mayor will run to flip Sherrill's House seat red
